description: This file defines a PHP class 'Order' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Task\Report' namespace. It manages various order report tasks such as adding scheduled tasks for different order statuses (sale, processing, complete, other) and provides methods to generate respective reports by interacting with models like 'sale/order', 'report/statistics', and 'localisation/order_status'. The class acts as a controller in the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for reporting and updating order-related statistics.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing order report tasks and statistics within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up scheduled tasks for various order report statuses and returns a success message.

methods.name: sale
methods.description: Generates and records total sales statistics for completed orders.

methods.name: processing
methods.description: Generates and records total processing orders statistics.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Generates and records total completed orders statistics.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Generates and records statistics for orders with statuses other than complete or processing.
